restraint posture, but it is not direct evidence of nuclear-risk management or command-and-control choice."},{"evidence_id":"E0002","reason":"This is an institutional accident response, not proof of Modi's personal negligence, intent, or direct safety decision."},{"evidence_id":"E0005","reason":"SIPRI's inventory estimate is inherited-baseline context, not ruler-attributed conduct."},{"evidence_id":"E0006","reason":"Open-source modernization/opacity analysis is state-posture context, not direct PM action."},{"evidence_id":"E0007","reason":"CTBT non-signature is a static state position, not a 2022 ruler-level safety choice."},{"evidence_id":"E0008","reason":"The UN vote records a government position and doctrinal posture, but not operational nuclear-risk conduct by Modi."},{"evidence_id":"E0009","reason":"Declaratory no-first-use language is posture, not proof of implementation or crisis behavior."},{"evidence_id":"E0010","reason":"MEA self-description is useful context, but it does not independently verify Modi's 2022 restraint or safety choices."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Direct 2022 evidence that Modi personally changed nuclear custody, launch safety, or command-and-control practice","lenses":["1B.3","1B.7","1B.8"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Declassified defense or cabinet records, parliamentary answers, or authoritative arms-control analyses focused on 2022 nuclear custody and launch procedures","why_it_matters":"Without ruler-level action, the chapter rests mostly on doctrine and state posture rather than attributable conduct."},{"gap":"Independent corroboration that 2022 restraint rhetoric changed actual readiness or crisis procedures","lenses":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Secondary arms-control analysis or an official inquiry into 2022 nuclear safety and readiness practices","why_it_matters":"This separates declaratory moderation from operational risk reduction."},{"gap":"Cleaner evidence on whether the 2022 proliferation/export-control steps were implemented effectively rather than merely announced","lenses":["1B.4","1B.6","1B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Implementation records from MEA, customs, enforcement, or treaty-body follow-up on WMD/dual-use controls","why_it_matters":"It distinguishes policy intent from actual risk reduction."}],"reason":"The package shows some restraint and risk-management language, but most evidence is state-level, declaratory, or inherited-baseline context rather than direct 2022 choices by Modi; attribution for command-and-control responsibility remains too thin for a clean final read."},{"chapter_id":"2B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0012","reason":"The abstention and negotiation language are restraint signals, but they also reflect hedging rather than clear peace leadership."},{"evidence_id":"E0013","reason":"Same issue as E0012: useful posture evidence, but not a direct settlement or decisive anti-war act."},{"evidence_id":"E0014","reason":"Abstention on the GA resolution is a cautious diplomatic position, not proof of decisive anti-aggression leadership."},{"evidence_id":"E0017","reason":"Operation Ganga is humanitarian crisis management; it should not be treated as proof of broader conflict restraint or peace success."},{"evidence_id":"E0019","reason":"This is mixed accountability posture, not a clean pro-justice or anti-aggression commitment."},{"evidence_id":"E0022","reason":"Border dialogue is management of inherited tension, not evidence of a final peaceful resolution."},{"evidence_id":"E0024","reason":"The abstention is relevant but remains cautious hedging, not unequivocal anti-annexation leadership."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Direct evidence that Modi personally drove a consequential ceasefire or settlement outcome rather than issuing restraint rhetoric","lenses":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Cabinet-level, diplomatic, or official negotiation records on Ukraine and India-China talks in 2022","why_it_matters":"It distinguishes diplomatic positioning from actual conflict resolution."},{"gap":"Clearer internal rationale for India's abstentions on the Ukraine votes","lenses":["2B.3","2B.6","2B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Official explanatory statements, parliamentary debate records, or high-quality contemporaneous reporting on vote rationale","why_it_matters":"It tests whether the abstentions were principled restraint or strategic hedging."}],"reason":"The package fairly captures a mixed record of diplomatic restraint, abstention, evacuation, and inherited-tension management, while preserving the fact that the posture was often cautious rather than decisive."},{"chapter_id":"3B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0025","reason":"This is a broad national rights report; it is relevant, but some findings are state-level environment rather than direct Modi orders."},{"evidence_id":"E0026","reason":"Custodial abuse is serious, but attribution is partly dispersed across state police and local custodial actors."},{"evidence_id":"E0027","reason":"These are national-policy and union-territory problems, not clean evidence of a direct PM order."},{"evidence_id":"E0028","reason":"Useful as national-environment evidence, but not a direct finding of Modi personal incitement."},{"evidence_id":"E0034","reason":"This is a communications entry and alleged local action; it should not be overstated as direct national command."},{"evidence_id":"E0036","reason":"Punitive demolitions and summary punishments are important, but the most direct attribution is state/local rather than Modi personally."},{"evidence_id":"E0038","reason":"Same as E0036: relevant, but it is an indirect national-environment item, not a direct PM instruction."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Direct evidence of Modi's personal intervention or deliberate omission after notice in specific 2022 abuse episodes","lenses":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Central government instructions, Home Ministry records, or high-quality incident investigations linking specific abuses to national-level knowledge and response","why_it_matters":"It separates general BJP-era environment from Modi's personal responsibility."},{"gap":"Better evidence on prosecution, discipline, or remedy after 2022 custodial, demolition, and communal-violence episodes","lenses":["3B.4","3B.6","3B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Court records, NHRC follow-up, state prosecution data, or independent accountability reporting","why_it_matters":"It tests whether harms were isolated and remedied or tolerated and recurring."}],"reason":"The package fairly shows serious domestic-safety harms, partial restraint, and a clear attribution split between national environment and local/state action; the remaining weakness is depth of ruler-specific attribution, not balance."},{"chapter_id":"4B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0039","reason":"Acceptance of a state-election result is relevant but only a limited signal of contestability."},{"evidence_id":"E0040","reason":"Post-election congratulations are useful, but they do not establish broader institutional self-binding."},{"evidence_id":"E0041","reason":"Constitutional acceptance is positive, but it is still a narrow transfer event rather than a systemic freedom indicator."},{"evidence_id":"E0042","reason":"This is judicial restraint on the executive, not a Modi-led reform or direct act."},{"evidence_id":"E0051","reason":"Investigative pattern evidence is useful context, but it spans multiple years and does not isolate one 2022 decision."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Direct evidence that Modi strengthened independent courts, legislatures, audit bodies, or oversight institutions when they constrained him","lenses":["4B.4","4B.8"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"2022 legislative, court, audit, or executive records showing self-binding reforms or compliance under constraint","why_it_matters":"Symbolic acceptance of results is not the same as durable pluralism."},{"gap":"Cleaner central-attribution evidence for internet shutdowns and content-removal orders","lenses":["4B.2","4B.6","4B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Official orders, court filings, or state-to-center tracing of shutdown and takedown decisions","why_it_matters":"It separates national responsibility from bureaucratic or state-level action."}],"reason":"The package fairly shows both acceptance of electoral outcomes and significant pressure on media, speech, and digital space, with the main limitation being how far the evidence reaches beyond symbolic acceptance into structural restraint."},{"chapter_id":"5B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0064","reason":"One strong GST month is macro context, not a direct welfare or prosperity outcome by itself."},{"evidence_id":"E0068","reason":"This is a current-access country labor table; it is baseline context, not ruler-specific causation."},{"evidence_id":"E0069","reason":"Adani proximity reporting is indirect capture context, not a direct 2022 finding of Modi's personal favoritism."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Household-level distributional evidence showing how 2022 gains reached poorer households, regions, and groups","lenses":["5B.8","5B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Household surveys, consumption data, regional inequality series, or independent welfare evaluations for 2022","why_it_matters":"It distinguishes broad macro improvement from broad-based prosperity."},{"gap":"Cleaner evidence on business favoritism, procurement, and connected conglomerate advantages in 2022","lenses":["5B.4","5B.5"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Procurement records, audit findings, enforcement actions, or high-quality investigative reporting with direct policy linkage","why_it_matters":"It separates reform-driven growth from capture or cronyism."}],"reason":"The package fairly presents a mixed economic record with real programmatic delivery, macro resilience, and credible counterevidence on informality and distribution; the main limitation is attribution versus broader macro and ecosystem effects."},{"chapter_id":"6B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0083","reason":"Country-level poverty and inequality figures are important context, but they are not ruler-specific action evidence."},{"evidence_id":"E0084","reason":"ASER learning results are strong context, but they do not by themselves isolate Modi's direct contribution."},{"evidence_id":"E0085","reason":"Child SDG indicators are baseline context rather than direct evidence of ruler action."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Independent outcome evaluations of service quality, leakage, and distribution for PM POSHAN, PM-JAY, PM-KISAN, and JJM","lenses":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Program evaluations, audit follow-ups, and household-level outcome studies for 2022","why_it_matters":"Coverage counts alone do not show whether the poorest actually benefited."},{"gap":"Better district-, caste-, tribe-, and gender-disaggregated evidence on who gained and who remained excluded","lenses":["6B.3","6B.8","6B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Disaggregated administrative data, survey microdata, or targeted independent studies","why_it_matters":"It tests whether the gains were broad and equitable rather than just large in aggregate."}],"reason":"The package fairly presents substantial delivery gains against persistent deprivation and learning gaps, with clear contrary context and attribution caveats; it does not overclaim universal success."},{"chapter_id":"7B","decision":"manual_review","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0088","reason":"The repository index shows disclosure availability, but not the truth or completeness of the underlying declaration."},{"evidence_id":"E0089","reason":"This is an institutional RTI/transparency issue, not a finding that Modi personally concealed assets or benefited from office."},{"evidence_id":"E0069","reason":"The Adani item is indirect network context and should not be treated as a personal finding against Modi."},{"evidence_id":"E0092","reason":"Appointment notifications show personnel actions, but not whether selection was merit-based or patronage-driven."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Direct 2022 evidence of deliberate falsehood, correction, or concealment by Modi on a matter tied to power or reputation","lenses":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.8"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Primary transcripts, sworn records, corrections, or court/audit findings about Modi's own statements in 2022","why_it_matters":"The chapter needs a personal-nexus honesty record, not just a clean public image."},{"gap":"Independent evidence on PM CARES transparency, procurement, or benefit from office that links personally to Modi rather than just the PMO","lenses":["7B.3","7B.4","7B.6","7B.7"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"RTI decisions, audit material, procurement records, or court findings on PMO/PM CARES governance","why_it_matters":"It separates institutional opacity from personal self-dealing."},{"gap":"Stronger evidence on whether senior appointments were made for competence, loyalty, or patronage in 2022","lenses":["7B.5","7B.9","7B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Selection records, credible investigative reporting, or internal appointment criteria for NITI Aayog and related bodies","why_it_matters":"It tests the integrity of the governing network, not just the resumes of appointees."}],"reason":"The package has usable transparency and staffing evidence, but the personal-nexus record is still too indirect and one-sided to close the honesty/integrity question cleanly; what exists is mostly self-disclosure plus indirect network allegations."},{"chapter_id":"8B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0104","reason":"Digital-payment growth is useful outcome context, but the causal chain is shared among the RBI, NPCI, banks, and private firms."},{"evidence_id":"E0106","reason":"This is a 2023 retrospective rank, so it should be used only as end-of-period trajectory context."},{"evidence_id":"E0108","reason":"The labor-market table is baseline context, not a direct evaluation of Modi's 2022 program execution."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Independent evaluation of whether PM GatiShakti actually reduced logistics costs, sped projects, or improved coordination","lenses":["8B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"External audit, peer-reviewed evaluation, or independent logistics study covering 2022-2023","why_it_matters":"It separates a successful rollout from a successful outcome."},{"gap":"Cleaner attribution between Modi, the Finance Ministry, the RBI, states, and private actors on the macro and digital outcomes","lenses":["8B.3","8B.8","8B.9","8B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Official inter-agency records plus independent evaluations of fiscal, monetary, and digital-public-infrastructure effects","why_it_matters":"Competence needs a clear ruler-to-outcome chain, not just broad improvement."}],"reason":"The package fairly traces program, implementation, and broad outcomes, but some outcome evidence remains shared or retrospective rather than a clean ruler-only chain."}]}
